front.uncertainty: Manual edge registration approximately1pixel; component heights, manufactured tolerances and mating geometry unknown.

materialBasis: Manufacturer reference photographs guide approximate colors. Materials and undocumented package finishes are visualization only.
assemblyNotes: Millimetres; source geometry is retained without scaling. Source revisions, omitted members and estimated reconstruction boundaries are explicit.
limitations: No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.
No native CAD located in the exact bounded official source search. Front appearance is photo backed; internal/reverse structure is UNKNOWN and package heights are estimates.
Only labeled BOOT is a physical GPIO35 hit target. RESET and unverified USER switch locations are visual only; runtime reset remains a platform action.

USB-C has an open approximate mouth but no pin order, connector part or cable mating claim. FPC, RJ45, USB-A, headers and other packages visible in the flat photograph have no verified3D internal geometry.
Purchased camera/speaker/PoE/10.1in display accessories are documented separately. This partial asset depicts the baseboard only and does not pretend that absent package geometry is reconstructed.
